name: Auto-populate Frame Helm telemetry from current Lancer source

operations.find:
renderMechStatsBar(data) { const stats = data.manualStats; return `
<MECH//STATS> Manual tactical telemetry

operations.replace:
${ stats.repairsAvailable ? this.renderPairedStat({ label: "REP", currentName: "repairsCurrent", maximumName: "repairsMax", currentValue: stats.repairsCurrent, maximumValue: stats.repairsMax }) : `
REP N/A
` }
